# Canaan Care

> Canaan Care is a home care company providing compassionate, personalized in-home support for seniors in Edmonton, Alberta, and surrounding communities.

Canaan Care helps seniors remain safe, independent, and comfortable in their own homes through trained, background-checked caregivers. Care plans are customized to each client's needs and can typically begin within 24–48 hours of an initial consultation.

## Contact
- Phone: +1-587-416-5717
- Email: getcare@canaan care.ca
- Address: 9008 51 Avenue Northwest, Edmonton, AB T6E 5X4, Canada
- Book a consultation: https://canaancare.ca/index.html#booking

## Service Area
Edmonton, St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Leduc, Beaumont, Fort Saskatchewan, Devon

## Services
- [Personal Care](https://canaancare.ca/canaan-care-homecare-edmonton-personal-care.html): Help with bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and mobility.
- [Companionship Care](https://canaancare.ca/canaan-care-homecare-edmonton-companionship-care.html): Conversation, hobbies, light outings, and consistent companionship.
- [Dementia & Alzheimer's Care](https://canaancare.ca/canaan-care-homecare-edmonton-dementia-care.html): Specialist support for seniors living with dementia and Alzheimer's.
- [Respite Care](https://canaancare.ca/canaan-care-homecare-edmonton-respite-care.html): Temporary relief care giving family caregivers a guaranteed break.
- [Overnight Care](https://canaancare.ca/canaan-care-homecare-edmonton-overnight-care.html): Overnight supervision and support.
- [Custom Care](https://canaancare.ca/canaan-care-homecare-edmonton-custom-care.html): Care plans built around unique client needs and schedules.

## Booking
Prospective clients can request a free consultation via the booking form on the homepage, or by calling +1-587-416-5717 directly. Care can typically start within 24–48 hours of the initial assessment.
